d.head: 44f6d52abbf5de4cad36b0309b4d923d70f83d78
d.f: Staged Alpha4 checks same-service owner equality before rejecting RELEASE_PENDING/RELEASING/UNKNOWN_RECOVERY; all three same-service transitional states return READY+Arm
d.risk: startup authority barrier can open while daemon-side lease cleanup/recovery remains explicitly unresolved
d.next: move transitional-state rejection before same-service acceptance; add three same-service focused tests

en: Critical pre-landing Alpha4 finding: same-service RELEASE_PENDING, RELEASING, and UNKNOWN_RECOVERY are currently classified READY/Arm because owner identity is checked before lifecycle stability. Reorder those checks before applying the staged runtime patch.
